values.note: City of Sault Ste. Marie user fees from 7/1/2026 (approved 2/16/2026): rustic sites $25 a night ($150/week, $550/month), sewer & water $35 ($200/$700), full hook-up (electric, water, sewer) $50 ($300/$1,100); seasonal rustic $600, residents only. $8 online/credit-card registration fee, non-refundable. Campspot quotes the same $25 and $50 site rates plus the $8 'Reservation Fee' and its own booking fee (3%, at least $3). One rate for everyone (no non-resident rate). Read 2026-10-25.

fees.source: https://www.saultcity.com/sites/g/files/vyhlif13741/files/media/finance/file/16646/2026-2027%20Approved%20User%20Fees%20updated%207-6-26.pdf (Parks & Recreation - Summer, 1 Sherman Park, 7/1/2026 column: 'Daily - Full Hook-up $50.00', 'Daily - Sewer & Water $35.00', 'Daily - Rustic $25.00', 'Registration Fees, online/credit card $8.00') + Campspot availability API for park 6162 (RUSTIC $25.00 and FULL HOOK-UP $50.00 site charge, 'Reservation Fee' $8.00, every type open to Motorhome), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: Campspot park record for shermanparkcg (FULL HOOK-UP type: '20-Amp', '30-Amp', '50-Amp', 'Sewer Hook-Up', 'Water Hook-Up'; WATER - SEWER type: sewer and water, no electric) + the city's fee schedule ('Campground Sites with Full Hook-up (electric, water, sewer)', 'Campground Sites with Sewer and Water'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Campspot lists 17 bookable RV sites: 2 full hook-up and 9 water-sewer (to 40 ft), 6 rustic (to 42 ft), all back-in. The city sells monthly and resident-only seasonal rustic sites besides.

sites.source: Campspot park record for shermanparkcg (site types FULL HOOK-UP 2 sites max 40 ft, WATER - SEWER 9 sites max 40 ft, RUSTIC 6 sites max 42 ft, all 'Back-In'), read 2026-10-25

season.source: https://www.saultcity.com/sites/g/files/vyhlif13741/files/media/parksrec/file/15751/Aune%20%26amp%3B%20Sherman%20Campground%202026%20Season%20Announcement%20Email.pdf ('The entire 2026 season, May 15 - Oct 15') + Campspot closed dates 2026-10-15 to 2027-05-15, read 2026-10-25

values.note: The city's page now sends 'Online Reservation System - NOW OPEN' to Campspot (it was BookMySites in 2026). Payment in full at booking; no mail reservations. In 2026 the season opened for booking in March, stays of 15+ nights two days before any length; Campspot had no 2027 dates yet on 2026-10-25. Staff: (906) 632-3268.

booking.source: https://www.saultcity.com/parksrec/page/sherman-park-campground ('Online Reservation System - NOW OPEN' -> https://www.campspot.com/book/shermanparkcg) + https://www.saultcity.com/sites/g/files/vyhlif13741/files/media/parksrec/file/15751/Aune%20%26amp%3B%20Sherman%20Campground%202026%20Season%20Announcement%20Email.pdf ('All reservations will be made through the online reservation system', 'Payment in full is due at the time the reservation is made'), read 2026-10-25

note: Modernized 68.7-acre city campground on the upper St. Marys River (the city's public beach), operated by the City of Sault Ste. Marie. RV Life's low rating rests on a single 2023 restroom-vandalism review; a 2025 review reports it clean. --Claude
summary: Read the city's page, its 2026 season announcement and the 7/1/2026 fee schedule, and the Campspot engine the city now links. Added fees $25 rustic (Campspot offers it to motorhomes, to 42 ft) to $50 full hookup, $8 reservation fee; 50-amp with water/sewer confirmed; season May 15 - Oct 15; booking moved to Campspot (url set). Not stated: total site count (Campspot lists 17 bookable RV sites), facilities, walk-up policy (fcfs some_sites left as derived). Note trimmed of booking/season/hookup text.
flags: Website: the entry's second link (https://sherman.bookmysites.com/widget/map_availability) is the old booking system; the city's page now links https://www.campspot.com/book/shermanparkcg as 'Online Reservation System - NOW OPEN'. Replace the BookMySites link with the Campspot one.

Seasonal/monthly share not posted: Campspot sells only 17 RV sites (2 full hook-up, 9 water-sewer, 6 rustic) nightly, and the city also sells monthly sites and resident-only seasonal rustic sites; the total site count isn't published, so the nightly share can't be stated. Nightly rates are posted and sold online, so test 2 passes.
